description.content: Create API endpoints for facility management (Facility, Venue, Ground) with proper role-based access control

details.content:
# Facility Management API

## Endpoints to Create

### Facilities
- POST /api/facilities - Create facility (SUPER_ADMIN, SYSTEM_SUPPORT)
- GET /api/facilities - List all facilities
- GET /api/facilities/:id - Get facility details
- PUT /api/facilities/:id - Update facility (FACILITY_MANAGER, SUPER_ADMIN)
- DELETE /api/facilities/:id - Delete facility (SUPER_ADMIN)

### Venues
- POST /api/facilities/:facilityId/venues - Create venue
- GET /api/facilities/:facilityId/venues - List venues
- GET /api/venues/:id - Get venue details
- PUT /api/venues/:id - Update venue (VENUE_MANAGER, FACILITY_MANAGER)
- DELETE /api/venues/:id - Delete venue

### Grounds
- POST /api/facilities/:facilityId/grounds - Create ground
- GET /api/facilities/:facilityId/grounds - List grounds
- GET /api/grounds/:id - Get ground details
- PUT /api/grounds/:id - Update ground (GROUND_MANAGER, FACILITY_MANAGER)
- DELETE /api/grounds/:id - Delete ground

## Access Control
- Implement role-based middleware checking user.primaryRole.code
- Verify facility/venue/ground manager assignments
- Implement scope-based authorization (FACILITY, VENUE, GROUND scopes)

description.content: Implement comprehensive role-based access control middleware supporting all 22 roles and permission checks

details.content:
# RBAC Middleware Implementation

## Middleware Functions to Create

### requireRole(roleCodes: string[])
- Check if user.primaryRole.code is in allowed roles
- Support multiple role codes
- Return 403 if unauthorized

### requirePermission(permission: string)
- Check if user.primaryRole.permissions contains permission
- Parse JSON permissions object
- Return 403 if permission not granted

### requireScope(scope: string)
- Check if user.primaryRole.scope matches required scope
- Support GLOBAL, CLUB, FACILITY, VENUE, GROUND, INDEPENDENT, USER scopes
- Return 403 if scope doesn't match

### requireAnyRole(roleCodes: string[])
- Check if user has any role from the list (via UserRoleAssignment)
- Support multi-role users
- Return 403 if no matching role found

## Usage Examples
```typescript
router.post('/facilities', requireAuth, requireRole(['SUPER_ADMIN', 'SYSTEM_SUPPORT']), createFacility);
router.put('/venues/:id', requireAuth, requirePermission('canManageVenue'), updateVenue);
router.get('/club/data', requireAuth, requireScope('CLUB'), getClubData);
```
